backtest_protocol.execution_model: AccountsPayableCurrent / AccountsPayableTradeCurrent are read as raw SEC Companyfacts balance-sheet INSTANT facts and matched to standalone quarterly COGS facts with 60-130 day durations. Both payable points and COGS flows are known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current DPO uses average current/previous payables over current quarterly COGS; prior DPO uses average prior-year comparable-quarter payables/previous payables over prior-year comparable quarterly COGS. The rule requires DPO to extend versus that comparable quarter while COGS is not materially contracting and gross profit, when available, is not materially contracting. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: This tests a materially different free PIT working-capital field from receivables collection, inventory turnover, debt, lease, and SBC: supplier-financing / bargaining-power improvement. The disconfirmer is that rising payables can also signal stress, so gross-profit/COGS stability and all three canonical windows are required.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC accounts-payable instant mapping, filed-date PIT quarterly COGS and gross-profit context, comparable-quarter DPO extension gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
